summary: Text Color Contrast Bug Fix - All 17 tests PASSED. Backend testing confirmed: _is_light_color correctly identifies light vs dark colors, _apply_design_token_to_slide properly applies white text on dark backgrounds and dark text on light backgrounds, all 6 templates produce zero contrast issues, header bar detection works (width >= 1700), and slide type detection by title keywords works correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Text color contrast fix verified. Key findings: 1) _is_light_color(hex_color) uses luminance formula (0.299*R + 0.587*G + 0.114*B)/255 > 0.5 to determine if color is light. 2) _apply_design_token_to_slide sets slide_text_color='#ffffff' for dark slides (title/quiz/summary) and slide_text_color from palette.text for light content slides. 3) _replace_text_color inner function replaces text colors in HTML inline styles: white on dark, dark on light. 4) Tech template correctly uses white text on both primary (#0a0a0a) AND contentBg (#111827) since both are dark. 5) Header bars (y<=5, width>=1700, height 40-55) are skipped for text color replacement and rebuilt with _build_header_bar instead. 6) Slide type detection works via title keywords when type field is missing.

_is_light_color helper.details: Correctly identifies light colors (luminance>0.5) vs dark colors. #ffffff=light, #111827=dark, #0a0a0a=dark, #f8fafc=light

Text color on dark slides.details: Title/quiz/summary slides with dark primary background correctly get white text (#ffffff)

Text color on light slides.details: Content slides with light contentBg correctly get dark text from palette.text

All 6 templates no contrast issues.details: corporativo, educacional, minimalista, tech, criativo, elegante - all produce readable text with proper contrast

Header bar detection.details: Header bars at y<=5 with width>=1700 correctly detected and rebuilt with accent color, not modified by _replace_text_color

Slide type detection by keywords.details: Slides without explicit type field correctly detected by title keywords: capa/cover→title, quiz/prova→quiz, resumo/summary→summary

bug_fix_verification.original_bug: Light text on light backgrounds after template application made slides 'muito embranquecido' (washed out)
bug_fix_verification.root_cause: Text colors were not being updated to match new background colors in _apply_design_token_to_slide
bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: Simplified _replace_text_color to always use #ffffff on dark slides and palette.text on light slides based on _is_light_color(content_bg)
bug_fix_verification.verification_status: CONFIRMED FIXED - all slides now have appropriate text contrast
